AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented

8.
PM Traffic Control – PVDW and Via Corta Intersection and Adoption of Resolution R19-20 for Budget Appropriation Thereof
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution R19-20 appropriating $9,800 of unallocated General Fund balance and authorize staff to enter into a contract with Black Knight Patrol, LLC for traffic control services from September 3, 2019 to November 1, 2019 and obtain and install the required regulatory signs and obtain and place the CMS signs along PVDW.
Staff Report

Recommendation: Receive & File
Staff Report
10.
Approval of Contract with Fire Grazers Inc. For Use of Goats for FY 19/20 Weed Abatement in Fire Zones ID 13A and 13B.
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council authorize a contract with Fire Grazer's Inc. and contract modification with Venco Western, Inc. for FY 19/20 Weed Abatement in Fire Zones ID 13A and 13B to allow the use of goats to perform fire safety weed abatement in Lunada Canyon, and authorize the City Manager to execute the necessary agreements as approved by the City Attorney.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)
11.
Adoption of Resolution R19-21 Amending the Schedule of Fines for Administrative Citations Pertaining to Violations of 18.04.021.C, 18.04.021.D, 18.08.011.C, 18.08.011.D 18.12.030.Q, and 18.12.030.R of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code in Accordance with Short-Term Rental Violations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing and adopt Resolution No. R19-21 amending the fine schedule for administrative citations pertaining to short-term rental violations.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
12.
Introduction on First Reading of Ordinance No. O19-737; an Ordinance of the City Council Amending Section 8.28.040 of the Municipal Code Regulating the Use of Leaf Blowers
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council introduce upon first reading Ordinance No. O19-737 amending Section 8.28.030 of the Municipal Code to regulate the use of leaf blowers.
Staff Report
13.
Introduction on First Reading of Ordinance No. O19-738; an Ordinance of the City Council Amending Section 2.04.010 of the Municipal Code to Change the Starting Time of City Council Regular Meetings
Recommendation: It is recommended that City Council adopt Ordinance No. O19-738 amending the Municipal Code to change the start time of regular City Council meetings to 6:30 p.m.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
14.
Update the FY 2019-20 Investment Policy and Adopt Resolution R19-22
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the recommendation to adopt the FY 2019-2020 updated Investment Policy for the City of Palos Verdes Estates and adopt the related Resolution R19-22.
Staff Report
15.
Approval of a Professional Services Agreement with Lewis-McCrary Partners, Inc. to Update the 2017 Police Operations Study and Appropriation of Funds
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the recommendation of the Council Ad Hoc Committee and approve the proposed professional services agreement with Lewis-McCrary Partners, Inc. to update and expand on the 2017 Police Operational Study and adopt Resolution R19-23 appropriating funds for the described services, and adjusting the FY19-20 budget.
Staff Report
16.
Consideration of Banning the Use of Chemical Pesticides for Landscape Maintenance Activities Conducted by the City
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the options for implementing banning the use of chemical pesticides and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
17.
Implementation of Various Capital Improvement Projects
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize continued implementation of Capital Improvement projects as identified in Attachment A.
Staff Report
